name: James Bodnar
office: Crescenta Valley Water District, Member, Board of Directors

items.text: James Bodnar, a licensed civil engineer, was elected to the Crescenta Valley Water District board in 2009 and is its 2026 president. In 2013, he said he wanted to keep water rates low and review the rate structure. In 2019, he presided over a hearing on proposed water and sewer rate increases. In 2026, he voted to authorize a $2.7 million construction contract.
